mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where FEDFUNDS has been above 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market characterized by unemployment rate below 3.5%, the strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction activity that supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1300 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of expanding industrial production (INDPRO above 102.0), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO exceeds 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% from the previous quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a monetary policy response to high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient.
